clue.text: Fervent god had a look in

indicators.note: in tells us the pieces for 'a look' go inside the name of the god

parts.note: Zeus is the chief god of the Greeks
lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: A passionate deity peered inside somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'look' is not a gaze here but the old exclamation 'lo!'; 'had' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone full of passionate enthusiasm.

clue.text: Post at middle of local office

parts.note: a post is a job or position
the middle of something is its centre

explanation.surface: Someone mails a letter from a branch office in the middle of town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Post' reads as mail but means a position of employment.
explanation.definitionFit: A British Jobcentre is the local government office where people seek work and claim benefits.

clue.text: Architect gave companion spanner

parts.note: Sir Christopher Wren, architect of St Paul's Cathedral
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: An architect hands a tool to a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: CH, Companion of Honour, is a British honour; 'gave' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a wrench is a kind of spanner, an adjustable tool for turning nuts.

clue.text: Guys provide necessary support at this location

definitions.text: Guys provide necessary support at this location

parts.words: Guys provide necessary support at this location
parts.note: guys are the ropes that hold up tents, so the place where they do their supporting work is where tents are pitched

explanation.surface: Some men give vital help at a particular place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guys' reads as men but means guy ropes, which hold tents upright.
explanation.definitionFit: A place full of tents is where guy ropes are doing their supporting job.

clue.text: Return having already had slice of the abundant supply

indicators.note: already had says the slicing comes before the returning, so its piece goes first

parts.note: to slice is to cut
having here means with, or and
to return is to come again

explanation.surface: Someone goes back for more after already taking a slice of plenty.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase pictures a joint of meat one can keep carving from, hence a plentiful supply.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a source of plenty that never runs out, like a roast you keep carving.

clue.text: Both moving into shopping area find store

indicators.note: into says the scrambled letters are placed inside the shopping area

parts.note: a mall is a shopping area

indicators.note: moving signals that the letters of Both are shifted about

explanation.surface: Two people move into a shopping centre and find a shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' turns BOTH into OTHB. 'store' looks like a shop, which fits the shopping surface, but it is a verb: put away.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something in mothballs is to set it aside in storage for later.

clue.text: Endlessly say goodbye to the wise man

indicators.note: endlessly means the farewell phrase loses its final letter

parts.note: so long is a way of saying goodbye

explanation.surface: Bidding farewell forever to a sage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' drops the G from SO LONG.
explanation.definitionFit: Solon was the Athenian lawgiver, and his name now means any wise statesman.

clue.text: Time to get thing mended?

indicators.note: mended suggests the letters of thing are fixed into a new order

explanation.surface: It is time to fix something broken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mended' rearranges THING into NIGHT, placed after TO; 'get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This evening is a particular time, the coming night.

clue.text: Eat up although even half is in drab surroundings

indicators.note: in places the half word inside the gloomy word

parts.note: dour means gloomy or drab

indicators.note: half asks for the first two of the four letters of even

explanation.surface: Someone eats everything despite dreary surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'although' is just a link; 'drab surroundings' reads as scenery but tells us the drab word goes around.
explanation.definitionFit: To devour food is to eat it up greedily.

clue.text: Gossiping while making knotted lace going round lake

indicators.note: going round says the lace-making word encircles the letter for lake

parts.note: tatting is the craft of making knotted lace by hand
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Women gossip while doing lacework by a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: Tatting is a handcraft making lace from knots; 'going round' puts it around L.
explanation.definitionFit: Tattling is idle chatter or telling tales about others.

clue.text: Plate can be designed for embryonic tissue

indicators.note: be designed hints the letters of plate and can are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A plate and a can could be designed for growing tissue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be designed' rearranges PLATE and CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The organ in the womb that nourishes a developing foetus through the umbilical cord.

clue.text: Kindly head of government in African country

indicators.note: in says the leader's letter goes inside the country name

parts.note: Benin is a country in West Africa

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of government

explanation.surface: A kind leader governs a country in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head of' gives G, and 'in' puts it inside BENIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Benign means gentle and well-meaning, a kindly disposition.

clue.text: Subdued, having satisfied a thirst

definitions.meaning: a fire or rebellion put out or suppressed
having drunk enough so one is no longer thirsty

explanation.surface: Someone calmed down after drinking their fill.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both put down or extinguished and having slaked one's thirst with a drink.

clue.text: Salad food absorbs it with speed

indicators.note: absorbs means the salad vegetable takes in the little word

parts.note: celery is a vegetable eaten in salads

explanation.surface: Salad vegetables soak up dressing quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Salad food' hides a single vegetable; 'with' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Celerity is a formal word for swiftness.

clue.text: Way to understand good driving technique

parts.note: a way is a road
to sense is to understand or perceive

explanation.surface: Advice on how to learn safe driving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link between the wordplay and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means awareness and skill when travelling in traffic.

clue.text: Cola, a cup came from Mexican resort

indicators.note: came from suggests the resort is formed out of rearranged cola, a and cup

explanation.surface: A cup of cola was brought back from a holiday in Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: 'came from' rearranges COLA, A and CUP.
explanation.definitionFit: Acapulco is a beach city on the Pacific coast of Mexico.

clue.text: Crime not developing as a result of telephone system

indicators.note: developing signals the letters of crime and not change into something new

explanation.surface: A phone network arises because crime fails to grow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developing' rearranges CRIME and NOT; 'as a result of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An intercom is an internal phone network linking rooms in a building.

clue.text: Comment allowed on paper

parts.note: a note is a brief comment
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A remark was permitted in print.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A small folded sheet of decorated stationery for short letters.

clue.text: One making speech after Sunday for game-hunter

indicators.note: after places the speaker's word behind the letter for the day

parts.note: a talker is one who speaks

explanation.surface: Someone gives a speech after Sunday about hunting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts TALKER behind S; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalker creeps up on deer or other quarry to shoot it.

clue.text: Hasten tide ebbing gently into river

indicators.note: into places the inner pieces inside the river's name

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, England
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning soft or gentle

indicators.note: ebbing, like a tide going out, means tide is read backwards

explanation.surface: Hurry the tide flowing out quietly into the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ebbing' makes EDIT from TIDE; P and EDIT go 'into' EXE, a river in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: To expedite something is to speed it up.

clue.text: Vessel with a master on canal

parts.note: a pan is a cooking vessel
MA is a Master of Arts degree

explanation.surface: A ship with a captain sails along a canal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' reads as a ship but means a pan; 'with' and 'on' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: The Panama Canal is the famous waterway linking the Atlantic and Pacific.

clue.text: Delay one's retirement

parts.note: retirement here is going to bed, so putting it off means not going to bed late at night

explanation.surface: Someone postpones leaving work for good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retirement' reads as leaving work but means going to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay awake beyond one's usual bedtime is to put off going to bed.

clue.text: Be accommodating either way

indicators.note: either way says the letters read the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Be helpful whichever way things go.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a palindrome; 'either way' signals that.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone lodging, or to tolerate something, is to accommodate them.

clue.text: With extreme wariness, hotly?

definitions.meaning: in a spicy manner, as ginger is a hot spice

explanation.surface: Proceeding with great caution, and with some heat.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word as a spice plus -LY, a whimsical adverb, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means very cautiously, and whimsically also in a way spiced with ginger, which tastes hot.

clue.text: I'll float round the ships

indicators.note: round signals that the letters of I'll float are turned about

explanation.surface: Someone announces they will drift around the boats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' rearranges I'LL FLOAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A flotilla is a small fleet of boats or ships.

clue.text: Taken the wrong way

parts.note: reads as misunderstood, but means literally guided along an incorrect route, or deceived

explanation.surface: A remark that was misunderstood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taken' suggests misunderstanding but means led or guided.
explanation.definitionFit: Being guided astray, or deceived, is to be led the wrong way.

clue.text: Leave platform for another candidate?

parts.note: a candidate quitting the stage so someone else can stand, or a politician resigning in favour of a rival

explanation.surface: A speaker leaves the stage so another contender can speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'platform' is both a stage and a political programme, so the picture is a candidate standing aside.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign or withdraw from a post so that someone else may take over.
